says: Scene 2: a cloaked rider on a tall two-legged strider climbs a narrow ledge path cut into a canyon wall. Composed first this time: the path is a strong diagonal from the lower-left corner up to the rider and on to the vanishing point; the wall is a big form cropped by the right edge with strata converging on that point; across the void a far canyon wall with a giant carved stone head, drawn light; a ship hull cropped by the top-left corner. Heavy line in front, light behind, hatching that follows each form from the first pass, and pebbles as irregular little shapes with shadows.
